details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:2074-2091 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: `subprocess.run(..., text=True)` can raise `UnicodeDecodeError` on undecodable log output and that exception is not caught.
  WHY: The uncaught decode failure aborts the writer and drops the snapshot for that iteration instead of returning an empty tail.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:2065-2089 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The `details_url` job-id regex in `fetch_log_tail` is too specific and can return no match when the URL shape differs from the expected path.
  WHY: When the match fails, `fetch_log_tail` returns `""`, so the failing job contributes no `log_tail` and the autofix loop can lose the failure signal.
- scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh:439-445, 491-497 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The reviewer prompt does not explicitly instruct reviewers to consult `failed[i].log_tail` when `failed[i].summary` is empty.
  WHY: Reviewers can miss the actionable failure details already embedded in the context file, leaving CI failures unflagged for the editor pass.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:2115-2127 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The `writer_error` sentinel path omits all `failed[i].log_tail` fields.
  WHY: Any writer exception causes total loss of the new failure-detail data and reverts that snapshot iteration to pre-fix behavior.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:2078-2083 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The `gh run view --log` call has a hardcoded 60-second timeout and is not operator-tunable.
  WHY: Large or numerous failing jobs can accumulate N×60 seconds of sequential wait time before the fetch step returns empty tails.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:2051-2052, 2055-2056 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: `len(out)` is used on a Python string, so `CHECK_RUNS_LOG_TAIL_BYTES` is enforced in characters rather than bytes.
  WHY: UTF-8 logs can exceed the documented byte cap without triggering truncation, so the log tail may be larger than promised.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:168 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The `CHECK_RUNS_LOG_TAIL_BYTES` name implies a byte-accurate limit, but the implementation is character-count based.
  WHY: The env var name/backward-compatibility contract is misleading because operator tooling may budget for bytes while the code counts characters.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

  PROBLEM: `subprocess.run(..., text=True)` can raise `UnicodeDecodeError` on undecodable log output and that exception is not caught.
  WHY: The uncaught decode failure aborts the writer and drops the snapshot for that iteration instead of returning an empty tail.

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:2074-2089 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The regex pattern `r"/actions/runs/(\d+)/job/(\d+)"` is overly restrictive for parsing `details_url`.
  WHY: If the URL shape deviates from the expected path, the match fails and `fetch_log_tail` returns an empty string, losing the failure signal.
- scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh:439-445, 491-497 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The reviewer prompt does not explicitly tell reviewers to consult `log_tail` when `summary` is empty.
  WHY: Reviewers may miss actionable failure details already present in the embedded context file.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:2115-2127 | severity=medium | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: When the Python writer aborts early, the `writer_error` path writes only the sentinel and omits all `failed[i].log_tail` keys.
  WHY: That failure mode loses the new failure signal for the whole snapshot and reverts to pre-fix behavior.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:2078-2083 | severity=low | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The `gh run view --log` timeout is hardcoded at 60 seconds per failed check-run and is not operator-tunable.
  WHY: On PRs with many failures or large logs, the cumulative wait time can grow to N×60 seconds before empty tails are returned.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM x-ai_grok-4_20 ===
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:2065-2085 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The regex used in `fetch_log_tail()` can fail to match some `details_url` shapes and then returns an empty string silently.
  WHY: When the match fails, the log tail is empty and the editor falls back to unhelpful summary data, producing no-op autofix rounds.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:2115-2127 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: When `_writer_ok=false`, the sentinel path writes only `collection_status: writer_error` and basic metadata, not the `failed[]` entries or `log_tail`.
  WHY: Any Python exception causes total loss of the failure signals that the new snapshot path is meant to preserve.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:2043-2097 | severity=low | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The `gh run view --log` fetch is hardcoded to 60 seconds per failed check-run and lacks an operator-controlled cap.
  WHY: A PR with many failing jobs can add up to many sequential 60-second waits, pushing the snapshot step toward timeout.
=== END FINDINGS FROM x-ai_grok-4_20 ===
